title: Origins: Automaton
description: A moving mechanical device made in imitation of a human being. You can reprogram yourself to perform actions while idle! (For Fabric)
body:
# The Automaton
_"A moving mechanical device made in imitation of a human being. A bug in your system has caused you to gain sentience! You can reprogram yourself to perform actions while idle!"_
`Made for Fabric, Minecraft version 1.20.2, Origins version 1.12.10 impact: 1, Icon: Redstone Lamp`

### "The Script":
_"Edit your Script with ["Primary Active"] while holding a Paper, and then press ["Primary Active"] without holding it to Run it!"_
- [+] Fully Editable Script with 54 Slots!
- [+] Some of the Usable Items are visible ingame in The Origins GUI!

### "Overclock CPU":
_"Speed up your CPU by pressing ["Secondary Active"], or press ["Secondary Active"] while Sneaking to slow down!"_
- [+] Control how fast you want to follow the Script!
- [+] From 20 Actions per Second at fastest rate down to 0.2 Actions per Second (1 action per 5 seconds)!

### "Fuel Tank":
_"To run Your Script for one Cycle requires Fuel! Open up your Fuel Tank by holding a Furnace in your Mainhand and pressing ["Primary Active"]!_
 - One piece of Wood Log will give you fuel enough for 15 Cycles, Coal for 80, Blaze Rod for 120, Dried Kelp block for 700, Coal Block for 800, Lava bucket for 1000.
- Your fuel tank is a separate inventory with 5 slots, and it can handle multiple fuel sources, and it will deplete them in order of Best Fuel Source (as in, Lava first, Wood Last)
- One Cycle = One Script Loop

_Origin by Frucs!_

### "Known Bugs":
- Pathfinding is still kinda bad in FORESTS. If you find anything you feel is unintended, let me know on Discord!

### Important: This is just an early version: There is more to come, and many bugs to be found!

### The Items and what they do in your Script:
- Feather = Jump
- Target = Makes you look at closest entity
- Iron Sword = Hits what you are looking at with damage equal to an iron sword
- Iron Pickaxe = Mine Stone-type block you are looking at
- Any Axe = Chop wood-type block you are looking at
- Firework Rocket = Boost forward
- Bell = Activate Pathfinding, walk around randomly.
- Ender Eye = Look at where you are pathfinding
- Compass = Look North
- Red Wool = Look South
- Sunflower = Look East
- Green Wool = Look West
- Coal = Look at closest Coal Ore within 6 blocks from you
- Oak Sapling = Plant Oak Sapling where you are looking, consumes the Sapling if successful.
- Dirt = Look at closest Dirt block within 6 blocks from you.
- Oak Log = Look at closest Log of any type within 6 blocks from you.
- Bone Meal = Apply Bone Meal where you are looking, consumes the Bone Meal if successful.
- Ender Pearl = Throw Ender Pearl
- Bucket = Pick up Liquid
- Water Bucket = Place Water
- Lava Bucket = Place Lava
- Cobblestone = Place Blocks
- Stick = Stackable Action, Wait 5 Seconds for each item in the stack.
- String = Boost Backwards
- Furnace = Refuel Fuel Tank
- Apple = Rotate up
- Potato = Rotate down
- Rail = Rotate right
- Lime Dye = Rotate left
- Honey Block = Slow down CPU
- Sugar = Speed up CPU
